title: Heresy Trial
paragraphs: “…Are you referring to that matter? I believe I have already apologized for it.”
Apologized, you say? I could have you put to the sword right this instant, you know?
“Oh, come on now, that was just a minor dispute, wasn’t it? I think if we both handle this like adults, we can move forward.”
“I see. It appears the Shield Hero understands as well. So then, what is your business here?”
“About that… Thanks to your advice, I’ve grown.”
“…Is this going to be a long story?”
Apparently uninterested in hearing Father out, Takt said that. I see, I see. It seems he’s in quite the hurry to die.
“Alright, I’ll keep it short. Battle is about quality, quantity, and strategy, correct? That’s what you said, right? No mistake there?”
“…? Yes, that’s correct…”
“In other words, if someone is an enemy, then overwhelming a weaker opponent with multiple high-level fighters is also part of strategy, right?”
“Well, if you take it to the extreme, yes. If you hold back, you might cause unnecessary losses.”
“I see. That’s useful to know. But then, shouldn’t you have realized that coming here alone was a bad idea?”
“What? …Ah, so you and that pig set me up. But do you really think the likes of you can defeat me?”
Oh, look at that. He’s finally showing his true colors. Or rather, he seriously thinks he can defeat us? Even when he had his little group, he couldn’t even take me down alone.

He must believe that if he takes the Four Holy Weapons from us, there would be no point in hiding his intentions anymore. Well, if he actually won, he could parade himself around as some sort of divine miracle who wields all four Holy Weapons. Compared to that, the Pig King would be nothing.
“Yeah, I think we can win.”
“Hahaha, this is hilarious. A hero summoned just a month ago is seriously convinced he can beat me?”
HAHAHA. I’m not Takt, but I can’t stop laughing internally. Forget a month—someone like him could be taken down in a week.
“This works out perfectly. I’ve been fed up with that pig’s tyranny for a while now. I had planned to prepare a bit more, but this is a great opportunity. I’ll just wipe all of you out together.”
Takt spouted off his nonsense, and Father responded.
“The Four Holy Heroes aren’t weak enough to lose to a fake hero. Even if your level is 350, even if you have multiple Seven Star Weapons, even if you have the ability to steal the Legendary Weapons.”

Oh? Even Takt is shaken by that. That level—it’s what I told Father. He boasted about it in the first world, so I remembered. The number of Seven Star Weapons he holds changes over time. How many does he have now, I wonder?
Before long, Father turned his gaze toward me. I understand perfectly.
“The Love Hunter commands. Vassal weapons, respond to the call of the Love Hunter, break free from the foolish shackles of power, and awaken!”
Takt’s whip, hanging from his waist, begins to glow. Along with it… his hidden Seven Star Weapons as well.
“W-What!?”
“—I hereby strip you of your qualification as a vassal wielder!”
One, two, three… As expected, he had three of them at this point in time.
“W-What’s happening!? Ugh… My strength is draining! What did you do!?”

The Seven Star Weapons leave Takt’s hands and begin floating around us. I’ve seen this before. I haven’t even given the next command yet. Hopefully, this time, their rightful wielders will be found quickly.
“Oh… So what the Spear Hero said was true.”

Buhuhuhu… The Pig King grins as if he’s been waiting for this moment, while Takt clicks his tongue in frustration, having realized the situation. In a way, this is exactly the kind of outcome the Pig King desired, so naturally, his mood is excellent.
“Who are you calling a pig?”
“Well, I already knew that’s how you saw me.”

And so begins the inquisition. Yes, not just from the Four Holy Church, but from all the various religions that worship the Heroes. A trial against a criminal who murdered Heroes and pretended to be one himself.

As he said back in the first world, he likely thought of himself as the strongest Seven Star Hero, having gathered multiple Seven Star Weapons. From there, he probably intended to establish a new faction that worshiped him… Perhaps such a group already exists in the shadows? Regardless, the moment he defied the established, legitimate faith, there was no avoiding this reckoning.

“Buhuhuhu… Now then, former Whip Hero, Takt… I would like you to explain yourself. Why do you possess three Seven Star Weapons? Tell me—what happened to the rightful wielders of the two weapons besides the whip?”
“D-Damn it! You lot! Come forth!”

In a desperate bid to reclaim the weapons, Takt activates what appears to be a monster crest or some sort of ability before lunging at us. This outcome was entirely predictable. That’s precisely why we lured him into the temple instead of confronting him in the throne room.
“Hand over your weapons!”
“Unfortunately—”
“Yes, to someone like you—”
“There are no weapons for you to take.”
“This time, it’s your turn to fall into a trap! Paralyze Lance X!”
Ren uses a skill with a sleep effect. Itsuki follows up with an illusion effect. Father, using Air One-Way Shield, forcibly redirects Takt’s punch, causing him to lose his balance and fall.

This is for Sakura! That said, we must not kill him. I unleashed Paralyze Lance at maximum output. Takt’s level is quite high, after all. I struck him multiple times in succession. In an instant, his limbs and torso were pierced, rendering him completely paralyzed.
“Ugh!?”
Takt collapsed.

Kukuku… Just as planned. This isn’t cowardice—this is strategy. Takt himself advocated for overwhelming an enemy with multiple attackers. As Father from the first world would say: ‘If someone does it to you, do it back.’ Immediately, the surrounding mages deployed multiple layers of analysis magic on Takt.
“Break Spell Lancer X!”
I forcibly evaporated Takt’s magic, ensuring he couldn’t interfere with their analysis. Now, he was completely exposed.
“Analysis complete… level 335! His level is far higher than the reports indicated!”

Oh? He seems to be slightly weaker than in the first world. Well, in that world, we fought him a few months later than this, so he must have gained more levels by then. Still, an increase of only 15 levels in several months… It only proves that he relied on high levels rather than actual skill.
“Buhuhuhu… We have also cut off his monster crest. Heroes, take a look—his allies haven’t even noticed what’s happening to him.”
It seems so. The pigs shown in the image crystal are lounging idly in the waiting room. Despite their beloved Takt being in serious trouble.
“Then, sentence him to Level Reset at once!”
“Yes, sir!”
At the Pig King’s command, the soldiers bound Takt and swiftly moved to transport him. However—
“Takt’s allies are approaching!”
The image crystal displayed Takt’s dragon, rushing forward with a ferocious expression. Hmm, even with the monster crest cut off, its instincts are sharp for a dragon. But this is perfect.
“That’s what they call animal intuition.”
“It sensed its master was in danger and came running…”
“So, we’re going to have to fight after all, huh?”
“Gaelion would come running if Father was in trouble too!”
“Yeah, when that time comes, I’ll be counting on you.”

Rival, who had been watching from behind as Takt was bound, spoke. Yuki-chan, Sakura-chan, Assistant, and Kao had been left behind in the waiting room of the Pig King’s castle. According to Father, this wasn’t something children should witness. Rival… was necessary here, and it also contained a parent’s consciousness. Since it was closer to a wild beast, there shouldn’t be any issues. Indeed, it had watched Takt fall into our trap without a word.
“Takt!”

Takt’s dragon reverted to its true form as it forcefully broke through the rear palace doors. Finally, it arrived. It took so long I was about to yawn. But now, they had committed the crime of destroying the royal palace.
“You bastards! What are you doing to Takt!?”
Father reluctantly stepped forward and raised his shield in front of the Pig King. After all, the Pig King is the king of Faubrey. Oh? It seems he has something to say.
“Buhuhuhu… It’s simple. We merely questioned the Whip—no, the man who falsely claimed to be a Hero and murdered real Heroes. And as you can see, the truth has been revealed.”
The Pig King lets out a vulgar laugh. Why is he so disgustingly unpleasant?
“You scum! Takt is not someone you wretches are worthy of touching!”

Takt’s dragon swelled even larger, revealing its true nature as an Emperor Dragon. That was precisely why we had chosen such a large rear palace for this confrontation. Originally, the plan had been to call them in and eliminate the Emperor Dragon separately, but… oh well.
“What are you waiting for!? Attack!”
“Buu!”
Takt’s remaining followers arrived. That said, their numbers were too few. Among them were griffins and pigs.
“Buhuhuhuhu… A diplomatic incident, you say? What a joke. Representative of Shieldfreeden, wasn’t your country’s Seven Star Hero…”
The Pig King turned his gaze toward the Seven Star Weapons stripped from Takt. So those weapons belonged to Shieldfreeden’s Seven Star Hero? I didn’t know that.
“Let’s ask right here and now—what happened to the rightful Seven Star Hero?”
